about: The jobs contract's shared vectors (story 122.1, syncular/README.md *Jobs*). `checks`: an envelope sent to a descriptor, encoded compactly in the key order written (or `envelope_text` verbatim), and the outcome of the contract's check: `accepted` (with the request digest) or a refusal code. `sequences`: commands judged in order from no rows, domain `d`, each with the server's clock, the attempt id it minted, the domain's open-job count, the outcome, the fields of the rows after it (`expect`), and which `jobs_page` units hold the job (`held_by`). A refused step writes nothing. Kinds here are data only. keeper reproduces them in keeper-jobs-api; keeper-hq's server tests after 122.2's re-pin.

sequences.name: submit-claim-complete-test-alpha
sequences.about: Full happy path for test.alpha with inline input, plan progress, effects on completion, and terminal refusals afterwards.

sequences.name: test-beta-different-shape
sequences.about: Exercises a second fixture kind test.beta with input_blob, node:gpu routing, plan, retryable failure exhausting max_attempts=1 into dead, and file_event effect.

sequences.name: same-client-reclaim-changes-attempt-and-epoch
sequences.about: Same worker reclaiming a live job mints a new attempt_id and bumps epoch and attempt, fencing the previous attempt.

sequences.name: a-b-a
sequences.about: Demonstrates A->B->A takeover across lease lapses, verifying conflict while live, rising epoch and attempt, and stale_attempt fencing.

sequences.name: renew-keeps-the-claim
sequences.about: Renewing a claim extends its server-side deadline so takeover conflicts until renewed_at_ms + lease_ms.

sequences.name: lapsed-but-not-taken-over-stays-current
sequences.about: A lapsed attempt remains current until another claim supersedes it, so completion naming its attempt_id succeeds.

sequences.name: second-plan-refused
sequences.about: Once a plan is recorded, a second plan from the same or a takeover attempt is refused plan_exists, mismatched digest is input_moved, and note-only progress succeeds.

sequences.name: release-then-reclaim
sequences.about: Releasing a claim with attempts left returns the job to queued and marks the claim released; reclaiming raises epoch and attempt; releasing the last attempt ends the job dead and moves it to its month.

sequences.name: fail-retryable-requeues-then-dead
sequences.about: A retryable failure with remaining attempts requeues on d/open; a second retryable failure at max_attempts ends dead on the month page.

sequences.name: fail-not-retryable-fails
sequences.about: A non-retryable failure immediately ends the job in state failed even when attempts remain.

sequences.name: submit-refusals
sequences.about: Covers unknown_job, too_many_open at 10000 vs accepted at 9999, duplicate job_exists, and not_due before not_before_ms vs accepted at not_before_ms.

sequences.name: long-job-moves-to-the-month-it-ended
sequences.about: A job submitted in October and renewed across the month boundary stays on d/open until completion moves both rows to d/2026-11.

sequences.name: declare-capability
sequences.about: Declaring capabilities sorts and deduplicates them under the client scope id and increments revision on replacement.

sequences.name: claim-with-a-stale-claim-revision-conflicts
sequences.about: Claiming with an outdated expected_claim_revision conflicts without mutating state; retrying with the current claim revision succeeds.

sequences.name: first-claim-with-a-nonzero-revision-conflicts
sequences.about: Claiming a never-claimed job requires expected_claim_revision 0; a nonzero value conflicts.

sequences.name: cancel-with-a-stale-revision-conflicts
sequences.about: Cancelling with an outdated expected_revision conflicts; retrying with the current job revision records the cancel request.

sequences.name: cancel-of-a-queued-job-ends-it-at-once
sequences.about: Cancelling a queued job immediately moves it to cancelled on the month page and refuses subsequent claims as terminal.

sequences.name: cancel-of-a-claimed-job-is-honoured-at-the-next-renewal
sequences.about: Cancelling a claimed job records cancel_requested_at_ms without releasing the claim; renew returns cancel_requested, and the worker can still complete with effects.

sequences.name: cancel-request-then-fail-ends-cancelled
sequences.about: When cancel is requested on a claimed job, a retryable failure with remaining attempts ends cancelled rather than requeuing.

sequences.name: cancel-request-on-a-lapsed-attempt-ends-at-takeover
sequences.about: A takeover claim over a lapsed attempt with a pending cancel request ends the job cancelled with outcome cancel_requested without minting a new attempt.

sequences.name: release-of-the-last-attempt-ends-dead
sequences.about: Releasing the final allowed attempt ends the job dead and moves both job and claim to the end month page.

sequences.name: lapsed-last-attempt-ends-dead-at-the-next-claim
sequences.about: Claiming over a lapsed final attempt ends the job dead with outcome attempts_exhausted without minting a new attempt, and a subsequent claim is refused as terminal.
